findings.text: High: wake runs inherit the bridge's AgentTalks credentials instead of the recorded actor/server. In-memory createWakeBridge test: Alice/A session, A-signed wake, Bob/B credentials in opts.env -> 202 woke:true; runner resumed Alice but resolveIdentity(runner.env) selected B with Bob's token. Content from A can therefore trigger actions with B's rights. Resolve credentials per recorded principal, verify the actor/server before spawning, and refuse mismatches.
